diagnostics.message: module.secure_baseline provisions organization-scoped resources (the CloudTrail organization trail via is_organization_trail=true, the AWS Config organization aggregator, the IAM Access Analyzer of type ORGANIZATION, and the audit bucket policy that reads data.aws_organizations_organization.org). All of these require the AWS Organization — with the cloudtrail/access-analyzer/config service principals enabled — to already exist. However, nothing in the graph makes module.secure_baseline depend on aws_organizations_organization.org: it is completely orphaned (no node references it), so on a fresh apply the module's org-scoped resources/data sources can be created before the organization exists and fail. Add depends_on = [aws_organizations_organization.org] to the module call.
